responsibility: Specializes the generic Moxie target configuration for the moxiebox execution environment. This OS/header variant changes predefined macros, linker and assembler specs, startup/library defaults, forces little-endian compilation through cc1 specs, adjusts multilib-related defaults and type macro overrides, and marks the build with TARGET_MOXIEBOX so the port targets the sandbox-style moxiebox runtime rather than the generic or Linux-style environment.
